answer_1.quote: Our task requires LLMs to track key stats across thousands of play-by-play records... We believe an LLM's ability to summarize key details and fill in the missing statistics in game summaries demonstrates its capabilities in data fusion and numerical reasoning.
datasets: NBA and NFL play-by-play data from ESPN.com
answer_1.outputs: Completed game recaps with missing statistics filled in

answer_2.quote: We measure the average absolute difference (deviation) between the models' predictions and the actual box scores, denoted as ∆Points and ∆GScore, respectively.
